name: Agent-First UI
synopsis: Let your AI agent hand you a real interface when a step needs a person — a window opens, values can stay live in both directions, and the session ends with one typed outcome.
intent: Host a Provider-owned Axum Router without interpreting its domain data or defining a shared domain UI protocol
Deliver a session through an isolated Chromium-family window, an explicitly managed direct URL, or a page served to a browser on another device
Route typed completion, window closure, and TTL expiry to the exact waiting session while revoking credentials and cleaning up resources
mutations: Add an optional bounded full-duplex session channel carrying Provider-defined JSON in both directions, with no envelope, request ids, or retained history
Add UiPage and a page feature so turning a frontend's files into a checked page is one assembly rather than one per Provider
Collapse window, link and session delivery into one call with an environment default, and offer link only when a Provider declares its expiry
Reserve the __afui/ prefix and let any delivery be ended through __afui/end, including a served page that nobody is attending
Make the served session list a replaceable frontend whose every card action reports pending, done, or failed
